title: Does LeWorldModel Preserve Local Action Geometry?
abstract: arXiv:2610.31716v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We examine how closely pretrained LeWorldModel (LeWM) reproduces the effects of small action changes. Using matched simulator and model responses, we measure action sensitivity with Gram matrices at three perturbation scales. Across nearly a thousand states from Reacher and OGBench Cube, the most sensitive action directions differ by median angles of about $36^\circ$ and $42^\circ$, respectively, at the smallest scale. Increasing the perturbation tenfold reduces median normalized Gram discrepancy by roughly 70\% on Reacher and 47\% on Cube. Geometry measured in pixels and embeddings varies more across scales than the chosen physical-state geometry. On held-out directions, environment Grams achieve median embedding response errors of 17\% and 28\%, compared with 26\% and 38\% for an isotropic reference with the same trace. translated_title: LeWorldModel 是否保留了局部动作几何结构？
translated_abstract: 我们研究了预训练的 LeWorldModel（LeWM）在多大程度上能够复现微小动作变化所产生的效果。通过匹配模拟器与模型响应，我们在三个扰动尺度上使用 Gram 矩阵来度量动作敏感性。在来自 Reacher 和 OGBench Cube 环境的近千个状态中，在最小扰动尺度下，最敏感的动作方向分别以约 36° 和 42° 的中位角度存在差异。将扰动增大十倍后，Reacher 上的中位归一化 Gram 差异降低约 70%，Cube 上降低约 47%。以像素和嵌入（embedding）度量的几何结构在不同尺度间的变化，比所选的物理状态几何结构更为显著。在保留测试方向上，环境 Gram 矩阵的中位嵌入响应误差分别为 17% 和 28%，而具有相同迹的各向同性参考模型则为 26% 和 38%。LeWM 在该尺度下的误差更高。这些发现支持对动作敏感性进行针对特定尺度的评估……
tldr: 本文通过在多个扰动尺度上使用 Gram 矩阵评估预训练 LeWorldModel 对微小动作变化的响应，发现该世界模型未能很好地保留局部动作几何结构，并提出应对动作敏感性进行针对特定尺度的评估。
en_tdlr: This paper evaluates the pretrained LeWorldModel's sensitivity to small action changes using Gram matrices across multiple perturbation scales, finding that the world model does not adequately preserve local action geometry and advocating for scale-specific evaluation of action sensitivity.
